name: Guess The Gibberish
desc:
Welcome to Guess The Gibberish, THE HARDEST GUESSING GAME ON ROBLOX PERIOD. 

🧠 In this game you'll be shown words that sound like complete nonsense but actually mean something, Can you guess what it says?
💸 Earn money by guessing correctly, every minute played
🛒 Use money on hints or pets
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play with friends to help you out

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones,  & Tablets
